entries.title: Job 20:1
segments: Then answered Zophar the Naamathite, and said,

entries.title: Job 20:2
segments: Therefore do my thoughts give answer to me, Even by reason of my haste that is in me.

entries.title: Job 20:3
segments: I have heard the reproof which putteth me to shame; And the spirit of my understanding answereth me.

entries.title: Job 20:4
segments: Knowest thou [not] this of old time, Since man was placed upon earth,

entries.title: Job 20:5
segments: That the triumphing of the wicked is short, And the joy of the godless but for a moment?

entries.title: Job 20:6
segments: Though his height mount up to the heavens, And his head reach unto the clouds;

entries.title: Job 20:7
segments: Yet he shall perish for ever like his own dung: They that have seen him shall say, Where is he?

entries.title: Job 20:8
segments: He shall fly away as a dream, and shall not be found: Yea, he shall be chased away as a vision of the night.

entries.title: Job 20:9
segments: The eye which saw him shall see him no more; Neither shall his place any more behold him.

entries.title: Job 20:10
segments: His children shall seek the favor of the poor, And his hands shall give back his wealth.

entries.title: Job 20:11
segments: His bones are full of his youth, But it shall lie down with him in the dust.

entries.title: Job 20:12
segments: Though wickedness be sweet in his mouth, Though he hide it under his tongue,

entries.title: Job 20:13
segments: Though he spare it, and will not let it go, But keep it still within his mouth;

entries.title: Job 20:14
segments: Yet his food in his bowels is turned, It is the gall of asps within him.

entries.title: Job 20:15
segments: He hath swallowed down riches, and he shall vomit them up again; God will cast them out of his belly.

entries.title: Job 20:16
segments: He shall suck the poison of asps: The viper's tongue shall slay him.

entries.title: Job 20:17
segments: He shall not look upon the rivers, The flowing streams of honey and butter.

entries.title: Job 20:18
segments: That which he labored for shall he restore, and shall not swallow it down; According to the substance that he hath gotten, he shall not rejoice.

entries.title: Job 20:19
segments: For he hath oppressed and forsaken the poor; He hath violently taken away a house, and he shall not build it up.

entries.title: Job 20:20
segments: Because he knew no quietness within him, He shall not save aught of that wherein he delighteth.

entries.title: Job 20:21
segments: There was nothing left that he devoured not; Therefore his prosperity shall not endure.

entries.title: Job 20:22
segments: In the fulness of his sufficiency he shall be in straits: The hand of every one that is in misery shall come upon him.

entries.title: Job 20:23
segments: When he is about to fill his belly, [God] will cast the fierceness of his wrath upon him, And will rain it upon him while he is eating.

entries.title: Job 20:24
segments: He shall flee from the iron weapon, And the bow of brass shall strike him through.

entries.title: Job 20:25
segments: He draweth it forth, and it cometh out of his body; Yea, the glittering point cometh out of his gall: Terrors are upon him.

entries.title: Job 20:26
segments: All darkness is laid up for his treasures: A fire not blown [by man] shall devour him; It shall consume that which is left in his tent.

entries.title: Job 20:27
segments: The heavens shall reveal his iniquity, And the earth shall rise up against him.

entries.title: Job 20:28
segments: The increase of his house shall depart; [His goods] shall flow away in the day of his wrath.

entries.title: Job 20:29
segments: This is the portion of a wicked man from God, And the heritage appointed unto him by God.
